title: cyanus orbelicus
intro: Cyanus orbelicus, commonly known as the Balkan cornflower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Cyanus orbelicus include reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and modulating the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
